sources.description: The uploader identifies these as trees creaking in windy weather.
sources.preview: Public HQ MP3 preview, not the original lossless upload.
sources.master_conversion: Complete HQ MP3 preview decoded, stereo averaged to mono, then resampled to 22050 Hz with normalized 256-tap rational-phase Kaiser sinc (radius 128, beta 8.6, 9900 Hz cutoff, reflect padding). Gain normalizes the complete master peak to 0.8. Original speed and pitch retained.

processing: Three separate recordings of trees creaking in wind. Full clip durations retained. DC removal, gentle high/low-pass filtering, short edge fades and gain toward former RMS subject to each former peak ceiling. The shared environment writer removes any remaining DC and applies its standard 10 ms edge fades. No synthesis, pitch shifting, time stretching, extra reverberation or denoising.
